data.name: Gamboa Rainforest Reserve
data.address: Goethals Blvd, Gamboa, Colón Province, Panama
data.description:
Surrounded by rainforest, this laid-back resort on the Río Chagres is 9 km from Camino de Plantación and 11 km from the Parque Municipal Summit botanical garden and zoo.
Airy rooms feature free Wi-Fi, flat-screen TVs and coffeemakers, as well as balconies offering rainforest or river views. Suites add separate living areas, and some have loft bedrooms. Room service is available 24/7.
There are 3 restaurants, 2 bars and a dance club. Other amenities include an outdoor pool and a spa. An aerial tram travels through the jungle (fee). Guided fishing, bird-watching and boat tours are available, as is kayaking.
